items.title: MiniMax H3-Image 2048x2048 renders in 12.7s warm on an M5 Ultra after a TensorFold weight-residency change, versus 16.6s with diffusers
items.summary: A TensorFold upgrade keeps all weights loaded between images instead of paging parts back in, cutting a warm 2048x2048 MiniMax H3-Image run to 12.7s against 16.6s for diffusers on the same Mac. Useful to people running image models locally on Apple silicon.

items.title: Seedream 5.0 Pro text-to-image and edit now served from US-hosted infrastructure on fal
items.summary: fal added ByteDance Seedream 5.0 Pro, both text-to-image and image edit, on US-hosted inference through its API, alongside Seedance 2.5. Teams that need image generation to run inside the United States can call it now.
